entries.source: SDK 16.4 and 26.2 PHASE.framework PHASEEnvelope.h and PHASETypes.h, byte-identical on the members; PHASE arrived in iOS 15 and the port's releases are 6.1.3 and 4.3, so there is no PHASE.framework on either. The two curves the header only names - Sigmoid and InverseSigmoid - were measured against the host's own PHASEEnvelope at t = 0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.875 and 1, and are a raised cosine and a mirrored half sine rather than the logistic their names suggest; all eleven agree with the host to 2.78e-17 in tests/backports/host/phase/run.sh
entries.reason: PHASEEnvelope.h:107-108 marks -init and +new NS_UNAVAILABLE; an envelope is made with initWithStartPoint:segments:
entries.effect: calling it raises, which is what unavailable means; initWithStartPoint:segments: is the way to make one
